summary_1line: Vasudeva recounts Parashurama’s lineage, the curse on Kartavirya Arjuna, Jamadagni’s murder, and Rama’s repeated extermination of Kshatriyas before their eventual restoration.

image_candidates.scene_text: Parashurama, blazing with fury and wielding his divine axe, hacks off the thousand arms of King Kartavirya Arjuna in battle.
The sons of Arjuna spear the sage Jamadagni in his forest hermitage while the sacred cow stands nearby.
Rivers of blood soak the earth as Parashurama stands amid heaps of fallen Kshatriya warriors after his terrible vengeance.
